text:
rohan: Heads-up — preflight for the 02:00 UTC change window tomorrow. We're pushing API=2.3.1, runtime=1.14.0, router header-split flag. Need to lock pins, agree rollback criteria, and publish a compact release note.
ida: Can we keep a 30m pin window for the router and console routes? router header-split is fragile in older clients.
leah: +1 30m pin. Also recommend a 5% canary for 15m before full ramp.
samir: Confirming runtime 1.14.0 has the new KV eviction fix? I saw a note in the changelog but want explicit verification from infra.
rohan: Yes runtime 1.14.0 includes KV eviction backoff. Infra ran perf smoke earlier; results looked green. samir — can you do a quick sanity on the KV eviction metric during canary?
samir: Yep I can watch kv/eviction-rate and kv/cache-hit during the 5% canary window.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run check passes for components: api, runtime, router. No active pins blocking. To schedule, run: ```/deploy start --components api,runtime,router --versions api=2.3.1,runtime=1.14.0,router=3.2.0 --canary 5% --canary-duration 15m --pin-window 30m --change-window 02:00-03:00 UTC```
ida: One more ask — add a quick migration note for customers using legacy auth header (X-RW-Auth). Router will rewrite to authorization header if present; need that in release notes.
leah: Rollback criteria proposal: (1) error rate >0.5% for 10m OR (2) median latency p50 increase >120ms sustained 10m OR (3) kv/cache-hit drop >7% during canary. If any triggers, revert router first, then runtime, then api.
rohan: Agree with leash order. We'll unpin router immediately if rollback triggered. Also, ensure console route is pinned to last-stable api variant during rollback.
samir: I'll own telemetry checks and postcanary signoff. Will drop a thumbs-up in thread when metrics look steady.
ida: I'll prepare the mini-release-note blurb: "Release: API 2.3.1 (client header handling), Runtime 1.14.0 (KV eviction backoff), Router 3.2.0 (header-split opt-in). Canary 5% for 15m, 30m pin window for router/console. Rollback triggers: 0.5% errors, +120ms p50, or -7% cache hit. See deploy command in ops doc."
leah: Quick smoke plan: post-deploy execute `curl -H 'X-RW-Auth: token' https://staging.internal/api/v2/health` and verify header rewrite in logs, then run 20 concurrent gen requests to runtime pool and check kv/cache-hit and p50.
rohan: Great. I'll queue the deploy in the bot for 02:00 UTC and set the pin-window/rollback monitors. Please ack when ready.
samir: ack, I'll be on watch.
ida: ack, release blurb done and pinned in docs.
leah: ack, will run smoke and post results. :rocket:
rohan: Thanks team — if no objections I'll flip the dry-run to main tomorrow at 01:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Dry-run scheduled -> main queue at 01:50 UTC. Notifications will post to #eng-releases and #oncall.
